evidence.reason: The child environment is built by spreading process.env, so GH_REPO is inherited by the gh child unless explicitly removed. GitHub CLI gives GH_REPO precedence over the checkout selected by cwd, so repo-root-bound commands such as editPrBody can act on a different repository. The supplied call path shows no GH_REPO removal or explicit --repo override; strip GH_REPO (and similar repo-selection overrides) or pass the repository derived from repoRoot explicitly.
